chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from his father from Abdullah ibn al-Mughirah from Ghiyas from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
that the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) placed a turban and prayed facing it.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling or practice regarding wearing or facing a turban during prayer in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith highlights the Prophet’s (peace be upon him and his family) practice of placing his turban (*qalansawah*) as a *sutra* (prayer screen) to demarcate the prayer space. This act underscores the Shia jurisprudential emphasis on maintaining physical boundaries during *salat* to preserve concentration (*khushu*) and prevent distraction from passersby.
